message.content:
I see! The fast loop has an assertion: `assert(oend - op >= FASTLOOP_SAFE_DISTANCE)`. This ensures that `op` is at least `FASTLOOP_SAFE_DISTANCE` bytes away from `oend`. So the 16-byte copy is safe because `op + 16 <= oend`.

But this is an assertion, which is only checked in debug mode. In release mode, it's not checked. But the code enters the fast loop only when `(oend - op) >= FASTLOOP_SAFE_DISTANCE`. So the fast loop is safe.
